name: Meeting Transcripts
description: Turns meeting recordings (audio or video) into a transcript with speaker labels and a summary - via Gemini. Every day it fetches new recordings from chosen OneDrive folders, processes them in a queue and sends a finished meeting to the Meeting Archive with one click.
author: androszr
